text: ssh nas 'for s in backup-nas backup-dumps backup-check backup-verify connect-npm-networks daily-recap; do echo "=== $s ==="; cat /boot/config/plugins/user.scripts/scripts/$s/name 2>/dev/null; echo; sed -E "s/((PASS|PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|KEY|WEBHOOK)[A-Z_]*=)[^ ]*/\1<masqué>/Ig; s#(https?://)[^ \"]*#\1<masqué>#g" /boot/config/plugins/user.scripts/scripts/$s/script 2>/dev/null | head -120; done' 2>&1: ut cocher les trois filtres a la fois : on dedoublonne sur # le nom, en gardant la forme annotee (nom(12x)) quand elle existe. Telegram rend # en police proportionnelle : une liste qui se repete devient illisible. PB=$(printf "%s" "${DOWN}${SICK}${LOOP}" | tr " " "\n" | grep -v "^$" \ | awk '{n=$0; sub(/\([0-9]+x\)$/,"",n); if(!(n in best) || $0 ~ /x\)$/) best[n]=$0} END{for(k in best) printf "%s ", best[k]}') if [ -z "${PB// }" ]; then line "$OK" "Docker $UP actifs" else line "$WARN" "Docker $UP actifs"; sub "probleme : ${PB% }"; fi # --- Sauvegarde (meme methode que backup-check) ------------------------------ if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -qix kopia; then LAST=$(docker exec kopia kopia snapshot list --all --json 2>/dev/null \ | grep -o '"startTime":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort | tail -1) if [ -n "$LAST" ]; then TS=$(date -d "$LAST" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
